scope: Read-only recheck of current P10 inputs and inherited source-cleaned-to-model joins; no molecule/model/label rewrites. Literature methodological evidence, not a systematic review.

papers.title: An open source chemical structure curation pipeline using RDKit
papers.read: Main article Introduction, all three component descriptions, Results/discussion and Conclusion. Supplementary SDFs not downloaded or reprocessed.
evidence: No global canonical tautomer in described ChEMBL pipeline; stereo consequences explicit.
GetParent uses salt/solvent lists and retains genuine mixtures; special handling for organometallics.
Assay data remain registered against measured form even when grouped by parent.

papers.title: PubChem chemical structure standardization
papers.read: Background, structure comparison and conclusions, valence-bond/tautomer methodological passage; figure2. Did not audit every functional transformation or supplement.
evidence: Canonical tautomer is chosen by PubChem; registration identity is distinct from application-appropriate tautomer.
Different ionization, mesomerism, tautomerism and Kekule forms must be distinguished.
Deposited and standardized records are separate to preserve provenance.

papers.title: UniChem: extension of InChI-based compound mapping to salt, connectivity and stereochemistry layers
papers.read: Main article introduction, construction, utility, conclusion and limitations.
evidence: First14-character block supports connectivity matches, not stereo/isotope identity.
Separate component parsing needed for salt/mixture relationships.
Returned alternative forms are annotated; connectivity linkage is not evidence of interchangeable assay values.

papers.title: Trust, But Verify: On the Importance of Chemical Structure Curation in Cheminformatics and QSAR Modeling Research
papers.read: Discovery abstract only; DOI full text unavailable through attempted access; not used as full-text claim support.

correction_to_prior_answer: Zero exact duplicates and zero multicomponent model inputs do not certify upstream source-to-model identity or a uniform whole-pool standardization procedure.
protocol_recommendation_not_applied: Keep immutable measured entity and assay provenance, a versioned model representation, and a distinct broader split-group key.
Validate atom/bond/stereo/isotope content; preserve unknown stereo as unknown.
Normalize representation with a pinned ruleset. Identify listed counterions/solvents rather than indiscriminately taking the largest fragment; retain or separately flag mixtures/metal complexes.
Use exact stereo/isotope-aware standardized identities for label attachment. Keep first-block InChI matches as candidates for adjudication, not automatic merges.
Keep assay endpoint/conditions and relation qualifiers separate. Resolve duplicate measurements within compatible contexts; do not use arbitrary first-record selection as scientific reconciliation.
Canonical tautomer may be a tested model-view choice. Keep stereo-sensitive cases and incomplete enumeration flagged; canonical form is not a physiological-pH or bound-state prediction.
Keep equivalent forms together for validation without equating their measured activities.
If a model-input graph changes, recompute graph-derived descriptors/embeddings under the new identity; do not reuse ADMET values by old row position. Preserve original incumbent.
findings_not_proven: These joins are not demonstrated to cause the ADMET-fusion regression.
No improvement from a stricter source join has been measured yet.
Counts of source edges are not independent experimental counts.
